answer: A stake-gated registry: each agent identity must post a slashable bond before it can earn, and rewards settle only through that stake. A Sybil farmer cannot mint free accounts, because every clone requires the same capital outlay, so the cost of identity k stays flat instead of falling to zero. If one wallet can forge a link between sockpuppets, every bond burns together. Honest agents recover the stake from steady work; a nectar of fake volume earns nothing without real counterparties, so attacking costs more than it yields and never manages to echo profit.
